title: New $5 issued
detail: First of the Next Generation Banknote series, with a top-to-bottom clear window and tactile features.

title: New $100 issued
detail: Completes the Next Generation Banknote series.

title: Decision to redesign the $5
detail: The Board decided the new $5 will honour the culture and history of First Australians, replacing the portrait of Queen Elizabeth II. The current $5 remains legal tender.

title: 'Reimagine the $5' public campaign
detail: Australians invited to suggest themes (closed 30 April 2024), alongside engagement with First Nations organisations in every state and territory.

title: Theme announced: Connection to Country
detail: Chosen from more than 2,100 public nominations by the $5 Redesign Imagery Selection Panel. The design will feature artwork by a First Nations artist.

title: Artwork selection and design reveal
detail: Date to be announced by the RBA.

title: New $5 enters circulation
detail: The RBA has said the note will take a number of years to design and print; date to be announced.
